preconditions.description: The input contains a single integer x such that 1 <= x <= 100.

postconditions.description: If x is 1, no valid pair exists, so the output must be '-1'.

postconditions.expression: x > 1 and (int(stdout.split()[0]) == -1 or (int(stdout.split()[0]) > 0 and int(stdout.split()[1]) > 0 and int(stdout.split()[0]) <= x and int(stdout.split()[1]) <= x and int(stdout.split()[0]) % int(stdout.split()[1]) == 0 and int(stdout.split()[0]) * int(stdout.split()[1]) > x and int(stdout.split()[0]) // int(stdout.split()[1]) < x))
postconditions.description: If x > 1, the output must be two integers a and b such that 1 <= a, b <= x, b divides a, a*b > x, and a/b < x. If no such pair exists, output '-1'.
